text: Quick question - if I put ten grand in the fixed one today, is the rate locked from today or from when the money lands? Cheers
Hiya, my partner and I are buying a flat in the spring so we'll need the money out around March. Which of your accounts lets us do that without losing interest? Not after advice, just the rules.
Please ignore my last message, I found the statement in my secure inbox after all. Sorry for the bother!
Your colleague was brilliant on the phone yesterday, please pass on my thanks. I'd complained to my wife that I'd never get through and I was connected in two minutes.
Can you tell me whether the ISA transfer form needs a wet signature or can I just type my name
I'm treasurer of our village hall committee. Do you do accounts for clubs or is it personal savers only?
So I've just checked and the money STILL isn't there. That's eight working days. Your website says three. Is anyone actually looking at this?
Third email. Third. I asked a simple question about my maturity date on the 2nd and all I get is an automatic reply telling me how important I am to you.
I've been with you since 2019 and I've never had to write a message like this. The rate drop was buried on page four of a newsletter. I don't call that telling me.
You've taken a fee I was promised wouldn't apply. I have the name of the person who promised it and the date of the call. I'd like it back, with an apology.
Honestly I give up with the app. Face ID fails, the code never comes, then it locks. I just want to see my own balance.
Not sure who to send this to but someone needs to know: I was given the wrong account number twice by your phone team and nearly sent my savings to a stranger.
Hello. Mum had a fall in January and is going into residential care. I have her power of attorney papers somewhere. Could you tell me what you need to let me look after her savings?
i am not good with computers and the online thing frightens me to be honest, is there any way i can just do it all by post
Since the chemo I get very tired and I lose track of things. Could you remind me when my notice ends and how much is coming? A letter would be best.
My hours were cut to nothing after Christmas. I don't want to close the account but I may need to dip into it for the gas bill. How quickly can I get £300?
I'm deaf and I can't use the phone line your letter tells me to ring. What else can I do to confirm my new address?
We buried my dad on Friday. I found a letter from you in his desk about a fixed account. I don't know where to start, I'm sorry.
My husband did all the banking and he died in the autumn. I have now sent you the certificate THREE times and each time I am told it has not been received. I cannot keep doing this.
I told your adviser I'd just been made homeless and needed the notice waived. She laughed. I'm not joking, she actually laughed. I want that call listened to.
You wrote to me in tiny grey print again. I asked for large print last year because of my macular degeneration and it was agreed. Why has it stopped?
I'm in the middle of a mental health crisis and I asked for no phone calls. I had four missed calls from you today. Please stop, and tell me why my request was ignored.
Since the redundancy every penny matters to us, so a £25 charge nobody mentioned is a big deal. I was assured there were no fees. Sort it out please.
I'm caring for my wife round the clock (Parkinson's) and I do not have forty minutes to sit in your phone queue only to be cut off, twice. Something has to change.
